text:
alex.k: Heads-up — freeze window starts in ~2h. Planning a quick sanity gate at +30m to catch any obvious regressions before the full rollout. Please confirm pins, canary size, and rollback plan.

maria_s: Pinning model-serving image to rwinf/model-server:v2.3.1 and runtime config to commit 9f2a7b. Will push chart change in 10m. :white_check_mark:

tj: For canary, suggest 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 30m if healthy. We should keep request-level fallback to small-llm for critical endpoints.

deploy-bot: preflight checks started for rwinf/model-server:v2.3.1

ci-cd-bot: Build and image scan complete — no critical CVEs. 2 medium advisories (not used at runtime).

maria_s: Chart diff (helm):
```
image.tag: v2.3.1
replicaCount: 4 -> 6
strategy: Canary(5% -> 25%)
```

alex.k: tj, agree on canary. slo for generation endpoints is 150ms p95 — keep an eye. Can we enable lightweight KV cache warming during canary?

tj: yes, enabling prefix cache warming via feature flag. I'll add the flag to the canary config.

sre_oncall: FYI I've pre-created the rollback runbook in runbook/rollbacks.md and set an alert on model-error-rate > 1.5% sustained over 5m.

maria_s: Pushed helm PR: https://git.internal/rwinf/charts/PR-482 — includes pin and rollout policy. Please review quickly.

alex.k: Running a quick smoke locally against canary image. If anyone sees anything funky call it out in this thread. I'll post the smoke logs.

tj: Quick checklist for this sanity gate:
- pins confirmed in helm chart
- canary 5% for 30m (monitoring + logs)
- fallback route configured
- rollback runbook linked
- security scan passed

alex.k: Smoke results: basic generation ok, latency looks fine. Sample: "Deploy sanity OK — small artefacts expected". No obvious tokenization regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy plan queued. Starting canary at 1769457000. Tracking ID: deploy-2026-03-20-54

maria_s: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary rollout, will post if metrics deviate.

tj: If error-rate spikes, we abort and roll back to image v2.3.0. Rollback command (helm):
```
helm rollback rwinf-model-server 2 --namespace prod
```

sre_oncall: I'll be on-call during the window and will take ownership of escalation.

alex.k: Thanks team. If no major issues within first 30m we'll widen to 25% and then full. Tag me for immediate approvals. :shipit:
